info.description: Self-hosted personal finance and budgeting API
info.title: Econumo API

post.description: Accepts a pending account-access grant, placing the account in the given folder (or a newly created default folder when the caller has none).
Creates an account (idempotent on the request id), optionally seeding its balance, in the given folder.
Creates an account folder for the user (name unique among the user's folders).
Removes the caller's own grant on an account, pending or accepted.
Soft-deletes an account. Requires ownership.

get.description: Returns all the user's available accounts (each with owner, currency, folder, position, balance) in reverse order.
Returns the user's account folders ordered by position.

post.description: Grants or updates a connected user's role on an account you own or administer. New grants are pending until accepted.
Marks a folder (and its accounts) hidden. Requires ownership.
Places one account immediately after another (afterId null = first) and sets its folder; returns the full list.
Places one folder immediately after another (afterId null = first) and returns the full ordered list.
Moves a folder's accounts into another folder and deletes it. Requires ownership of both.
Removes a connected user's grant on an account you own or administer.
Clears a folder's hidden flag. Requires ownership.
Updates an account's name/icon/currency and reconciles its balance via a correction transaction. Requires ownership.
Renames a folder the user owns (name unique among the user's folders).

post.summary: Add an account to a budget

parameters.description: Window start (Y-m-d, snapped to first of month; defaults to the current month)
parameters.name: from

post.summary: Remove an account from a budget

post.description: Marks a category archived. Requires ownership.
Creates a category for the authenticated user. Idempotent on the request id.
Deletes a category (mode=delete) or reassigns its transactions to a replacement then deletes it (mode=replace). Requires ownership.

get.description: Returns all the authenticated user's categories (archived and not) ordered by position.

post.description: Re-points every transaction and recurring template from sourceId to targetId, then deletes sourceId. Requires ownership of both. Cannot be undone.
Places one category immediately after another (afterId null = first) and returns the full ordered list.
Applies an explicit order (a full list of ids) to the caller's own categorys and returns the full ordered list.
Clears a category's archived flag. Requires ownership.
Updates a category's name and icon. Requires ownership.
Redeems an invite code, connecting the user with the invite's owner.
Disconnects the user from a connected user, revoking shared access.
Clears the user's outstanding connection invite (no-op if none).
Generates (or refreshes) the user's connection invite code.

get.description: Returns the user's connected users, each with the accounts shared between them.

post.description: Creates a per-user custom currency. Idempotent on the request id.
Deletes a custom currency. Requires ownership; fails if the currency is still referenced by an account, budget, budget element, or a user's profile currency.

get.description: Returns all currencies ordered by ISO code. The name is the English display name.
Returns all currency rates published on the most-recent available date.

post.description: Hides every global currency for the caller in one step; the base currency and the caller's profile currency stay visible. Custom currencies keep their per-currency preference.
Removes a global currency from the caller's dropdowns. The base currency and the caller's own profile currency cannot be hidden.
Clears the caller's hidden flag on every global currency. Custom currencies keep their per-currency preference.
Clears a caller's hide flag on a global currency.
Full replace of a custom currency's name, symbol and fraction digits. Requires ownership; the code is immutable.
Marks a label archived. Requires ownership.
Creates a reporting label for the authenticated user. Idempotent on the request id; the name must be unique among the user's labels.
Deletes a label. Transactions referencing it lose the association (transactions_labels cascades). Requires ownership.

get.description: Returns all the authenticated user's available labels (own + shared via account access, archived and not) in list order.

post.description: Re-points every transaction and recurring template from sourceId to targetId, then deletes sourceId. Requires ownership of both. Cannot be undone.
Places one label immediately after another (afterId null = first) and returns the full available list (own + shared).
Applies an explicit order (a full list of ids) to the caller's own labels and returns the full available list (own + shared).
Clears a label's archived flag. Requires ownership.
Updates a label's name. Requires ownership; the new name must be unique among the user's labels.
Marks a payee archived. Requires ownership.
Creates a payee for the authenticated user. Idempotent on the request id; the name must be unique among the user's payees.
Deletes a payee. Transactions referencing it have their payee cleared. Requires ownership.

get.description: Returns all the authenticated user's payees (archived and not) ordered by position.

post.description: Re-points every transaction and recurring template from sourceId to targetId, then deletes sourceId. Requires ownership of both. Cannot be undone.
Places one payee immediately after another (afterId null = first) and returns the full ordered list.
Applies an explicit order (a full list of ids) to the caller's own payees and returns the full ordered list.
Clears a payee's archived flag. Requires ownership.
Updates a payee's name. Requires ownership; the new name must be unique among the user's payees.
Creates a recurring transaction template. Idempotent on the request id.
Deletes an existing recurring transaction template.

get.description: Returns every recurring transaction template on accounts the caller can access.

post.description: Materializes one instance of a recurring transaction template as a real transaction and advances its schedule. Idempotent on the request id.
Advances a recurring transaction template's schedule without posting a transaction.
Updates an existing recurring transaction template.

get.description: Returns the latest Econumo release published on econumo.com (version + release-page URL), or empty strings when unknown. The client compares against its own version.

post.description: Marks a tag archived. Requires ownership.
Creates a tag for the authenticated user. Idempotent on the request id; the name must be unique among the user's tags.
Deletes a tag. Transactions referencing it have their tag cleared. Requires ownership.

get.description: Returns all the authenticated user's tags (archived and not) ordered by position.

post.description: Re-points every transaction and recurring template from sourceId to targetId, then deletes sourceId. Requires ownership of both. Cannot be undone.
Places one tag immediately after another (afterId null = first) and returns the full ordered list.
Applies an explicit order (a full list of ids) to the caller's own tags and returns the full ordered list.
Clears a tag's archived flag. Requires ownership.
Updates a tag's name. Requires ownership; the new name must be unique among the user's tags.
Creates a transaction (idempotent on the request id) and returns it plus the refreshed account list.
Deletes a transaction and returns it plus the refreshed account list.

get.description: Returns transactions for an account, or a date window across visible accounts, or all visible-account transactions.

Returns the authenticated user's live personal access tokens (without token material).

Creates a new user (when registration is enabled) and returns the current user without a token.

Revokes all the authenticated user's sessions except the presenting one. Returns an empty success envelope.
Revokes one of the authenticated user's personal access tokens. Returns an empty success envelope.
Revokes one of the authenticated user's sessions. Returns an empty success envelope.
Updates the authenticated user's avatar (Material icon name + color slug) and returns the refreshed user.
Sets the authenticated user's default budget and returns the refreshed user.
Updates the authenticated user's base currency and returns the refreshed user.
Updates the authenticated user's UI language preference and returns the refreshed user.
Updates the authenticated user's display name (length 3..20) and returns the refreshed user.
Changes the authenticated user's password after verifying the old one; other sessions are signed out. Returns an empty success envelope.
Updates the authenticated user's reporting period option and returns the refreshed user.

direction.description:
Direction is present only on rows of the transfers selector: "out" when
the included account is the source, "in" when it is the recipient —
Amount/CurrencyId are that side's. Omitted on every other list so their
bytes are unchanged.

labelIds.description:
Reporting labels attached to the row. Always non-nil ([] when none) so a
client can render it without a null check, matching labelIds on the
transaction feature's own wire.

accountIds.description:
AccountIds are the budget's initial member accounts. At least one owned,
non-deleted account is required — enforced as a coded error in the use
case, not here, so the wire carries the catalogue code.

side.description:
Side selects the envelope's (immutable) side: "" or "expense" (default).
"income" is reserved for the plan view's income envelopes and currently
rejected (see EnvelopeTypeFromSide).

labelIds.description:
LabelIds is ignored for a transfer (transfers never carry labels); each
entry is validated (parses as an id, exists, owned by the template's
account owner) by the service, not here.

sourceTransactionId.description:
SourceTransactionId, when set, is an existing transaction the template is
created FROM; it is linked to the new template (its recurringId) in the
same write, so the source immediately reads as the series' first instance.

labelIds.description:
LabelIds is ignored for a transfer (transfers never carry labels); each
entry is validated (parses as an id, exists, owned by the transaction's
account owner) by the service, not here.

Omit the field to inherit the template's labels; send a list to give the
posted transaction exactly those labels; send an empty list to give it
none. Absent and empty therefore mean different things. Each entry is
validated (parses, exists, owned by the account owner) by the transaction
create path, not here — same rule as CreateTransactionRequest.LabelIds.

userAgent.description: "" when the login sent no User-Agent

labelIds.description:
LabelIds is always a list, never null, so clients can iterate without a
nil check. A transfer always carries an empty list.

recurringId.description:
RecurringId is the template this transaction was posted from, null for a
hand-entered one. Read-only provenance: create/update never accept it.

accountIds.description:
AccountIds is nil when the client omits the field, which leaves membership
untouched; a present list replaces the caller's own member set.

labelIds.description:
LabelIds replaces the full label set (nil/empty clears it); ignored for a
transfer. See CreateRecurringTransactionRequest.LabelIds for the
validation rule.
